_comment: Story skeletons (what job the video does). beatmap_lint.py checks meta.intent against this file and warns when meta.format is not in the intent's `formats` list. hooks use the H1-H11 ids in references/02-intents-and-scripts.md. misconception=true means a 'what you probably think' beat is required before the answer. Source: writing and narrative research, 2026-10-20.

mechanism.name: How it works
mechanism.skeleton_30s: question about a familiar object | obvious answer or misconception + 'three steps' | at most 3 causal steps, one state change each | where the simple model breaks | model in one sentence + hook callback
mechanism.failure: a parts list; more than 3 new terms in 30 s; decorative b-roll; viewer feels they understood but did not

causal.name: Why did X happen
causal.skeleton_30s: event + the usual answer | stake | underlying condition (AND) | trigger (BUT) | outcome (THEREFORE) | 'not one cause' + the factor viewers did not hear
causal.failure: single-cause story; hindsight neatness; correlation presented as cause; wrong-event footage

concept.name: What is X
concept.skeleton_30s: question | definition in <=18 words | concrete example by 8 s | near-neighbour 'not the same as Y' | why it matters | recap
concept.failure: dictionary reading; abstract first; jargon chains; no example by 8 s

versus.name: X vs Y
versus.skeleton_30s: which is better? | same goal, different mechanism | dimension 1 | dimension 2 | the deciding dimension | conditional verdict | loop
versus.failure: more than 3 dimensions; unequal coverage; hidden criterion; unit or window mismatch; verdict without conditions

myth.name: Myth vs fact
myth.skeleton_30s: label the claim MYTH on screen and in voice | the fact, larger and with the last word | why the myth is believable + evidence | fact restated with one proof | takeaway
myth.failure: most time spent on the myth; no account of why it arises; fact less vivid than myth; unlabelled false claim in the first seconds

timeline.name: Timeline and history
timeline.skeleton_30s: then/now or striking image | at most 5 dated nodes linked by 'so' or 'but' | the hinge node | now
timeline.failure: date dump; and-then chaining; unannounced non-linear time scale; anachronistic imagery

news.name: What happened and why it matters
news.skeleton_30s: date-stamped what happened | known vs not known | why it matters (one concrete impact) | what to watch next
news.failure: stale facts; unattributed claims; no date; AI depiction of the event

numbers.name: The scale of X
numbers.skeleton_30s: hero number with unit and denominator | comparison 1 (familiar anchor) | comparison 2 (escalation) | the so-what | hero number again
numbers.failure: digits read as digits; mismatched units; non-like-for-like comparisons; more than 3 distinct numbers per 30 s

howto.name: How to / tutorial
howto.skeleton_30s: utility promise | finished result first | prerequisite (one line) | 3 imperative steps, one action each | the common mistake | recap
howto.failure: steps not matched to frames; skipped step; wrong UI version; stock footage of the wrong tool

case.name: Case study / breakdown
case.skeleton_30s: who + one-line outcome | the obstacle (BUT) | the decision (THEREFORE) | result with a number | the lesson
case.failure: hagiography; survivorship bias; unsourced numbers or quotes; fabricated dialogue; real-person likeness

ladder.name: ELI5 ladder
ladder.skeleton_30s: question | level 1 sentence + toy analogy | level 2 adds the mechanism | level 3 adds the hard part | what each level leaves out
ladder.failure: levels that are not truly different; jargon at the top; inconsistent analogies; viewer stops at level 1

list.name: Listicle / ranking
list.skeleton_30s: challenge | criterion in one line | 3 items (~5 s each), ascending interest | #1 with a twist | loop
list.failure: more than 5 items at 60 s; padding; unstated criterion; unverifiable superlatives

reveal.name: The hidden reason (mystery)
reveal.skeleton_30s: puzzle in 3-8 s | eliminate the obvious answer (BUT) | clue | reveal by ~20 s | implication
reveal.failure: reveal held to the last second; reveal does not match the tease; 'hidden' framing around unverified claims

predict.name: What happens next
predict.skeleton_30s: current state | driver 1 | driver 2 | two scenarios with calibrated terms | the signpost to watch
predict.failure: false precision; a single forecast; no as-of date; analogue chosen by hindsight

paper.name: Explain a paper
paper.skeleton_30s: the question | what they did (n and design in one sentence) | what they found (absolute effect) | caveat + so-what
paper.failure: press-release claims; causal verbs for observational data; relative risk only; preprint presented as settled; 'scientists say'

policy.name: Explain a law or policy
policy.skeleton_30s: what it does in one line | who it applies to | what changes and the effective date | what does not change | where to read it
policy.failure: implied legal advice; wrong jurisdiction; stale status; partisan framing

finance.name: Money and economics
finance.skeleton_30s: question | everyday example with numbers | mechanism | nominal vs real, per-capita | so-what | not-advice line
finance.failure: nominal vs real confusion; no denominator; cherry-picked window; advice-like tone; AI-persona monetisation rule

health.name: Health and science with risk
health.skeleton_30s: the claim | evidence level | absolute risk in natural frequencies | who it applies to | what to do or see a clinician
health.failure: relative risk alone; ambiguous single-event probabilities; observational data with causal verbs; 'cure' language; AI doctor persona

culture.name: Culture and etymology
culture.skeleton_30s: the word or custom everyone knows | the surprising origin | the path in at most 2 hops | the popular-but-false version | why it stuck
culture.failure: folk etymology repeated as fact; single anecdote as proof; stereotyped visuals

sketch.name: Comedy sketch
sketch.skeleton_30s: a situation with a rule | a character follows or breaks it | escalation, same rhythm (rule of three) | the turn | punchline, key word last | tag after the laugh
sketch.failure: explaining the joke; unclear stakes; the same gag with the same outcome as last episode; a punchline buried under specifics; AI-written punchlines nobody rewrote

serial-story.name: Serial story episode
serial-story.skeleton_30s: cold open inside the conflict | one-line recap only if the series needs it | what the character wants | the obstacle (BUT) | the decision (THEREFORE) | an outcome that changes the story state | an optional pull toward the next episode
serial-story.failure: the state does not change; a cliffhanger that is never paid off; a character acting out of character; a recap that eats the episode
